description: This file defines the implementation of absl::node_hash_map, an unordered associative container optimized for speed and memory efficiency, similar to std::unordered_map but with additional features like capacity() and pointer stability guarantees. It includes class templates, policies, and utility functions related to the node_hash_map container.

classes.name: absl::node_hash_map
classes.description: A hash map container class template that provides an unordered associative container with optimizations for speed and memory footprint, supporting heterogeneous lookup, capacity reporting, and pointer stability.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::NodeHashMapPolicy
classes.description: A policy class template used internally by node_hash_map to manage element creation, deletion, and access policies.

methods.name: erase_if
methods.description: A template function that erases all elements satisfying a predicate from a node_hash_map container.
